background: Worked eight years at Silverline Health before resigning to join a competitor.
personality: Direct, proud of a strong sales record, quick to feel accused.
emotional_state: Anxious about a lawsuit threatening a new job offer.
communication_style: Answers factual questions readily; goes quiet when the topic feels blaming.

fears: Being branded a thief of trade secrets

volunteered.text: I signed a non-compete when I started, but nobody explained it.

revealed_if_asked.text: The new company is in the same regional market.

rapport_gated.text: I emailed a client list to my personal account the week before I resigned.

concealed.text: I already started contacting former clients from the new job.

unknown.text: Whether the non-compete is enforceable under current New York law.

knowledge_boundary.unknown_response_style: I don't remember / I'm not sure.
